notes: Audited every health/score calculation and reporting site in the app after the 5.6.6 fix. computeAccountHealthScore(), computeSupportCaseHealth(), computeFeatureAdoptionScore(), and the other canonical scoring functions are self-computed from real fleet data (ASUP compliance, ARP status, firmware currency, case aging, etc.) with no ambiguous upstream field, so they were not affected. Grepped every use of a raw '.score' field across app.js and found exactly one more site using Active IQ's ambiguous recommendation `score` directly without correction: the QBR Pack deliverable (compileQBRPack) printed '[Score 27%]' instead of the corrected 73% health value. Switched it to the shared _resolveRecommendationScore() helper introduced in 5.6.6, so the on-screen Recommendations tab, the Section 12 TXT export, and the QBR Pack deliverable now all report the same corrected score.
